name: Made with Love
source:
Oliver Fraisola has been in an accident that has caused him memory-loss. All he has to direct him forward is a key that he wears as a necklace, with a mysterious "A" letter engraved on it...

With the key as his only guide, Oliver finds himself in the countryside town of Beranshade. 

After a series of events and his past start to unravel, Oliver begins to question: just what exactly is his connection to this town? And will he be able to recover his memories?

[From [url=https://otokeneko.itch.io/made-with-love]itch.io[/url]]
